steps: rm -rf {W} && git clone -q /work/in/main.bundle {W} && cd {W} && git checkout -q -B main {commit} && git remote remove origin && rm -f /work/in/main.bundle && git rev-parse HEAD
cd {W}/services/hyperfide && npm ci --ignore-scripts >/work/logs/npm-ci.log 2>&1 && npm run build >/work/logs/npm-build.log 2>&1 && ls dist | head -1

prepare: make -j"$(nproc)" cg >/work/out/{S}.prepare.log 2>&1 && (git diff --quiet {checkpointCommit} HEAD -- services/hyperfide/package-lock.json || npm --prefix services/hyperfide ci --ignore-scripts >>/work/out/{S}.prepare.log 2>&1) && npm --prefix services/hyperfide run build >>/work/out/{S}.prepare.log 2>&1

qualify.cmd: (./cg spec start -f {feature} {task} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); HYPERFIDE_PG_BIN=/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin CG_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS=300000 python3 tests/hyperfide/support/withpg.py -- ./cg spec done -f {feature} {task}
